exposure: late-onset GDM (diagnosed between 24 and 28 weeks of gestation)
cohort: 600 singleton pregnant women with normal early GDM screening
finding: Independent risk factors for late-onset GDM included abnormal 1-hour value of 100-g OGTT from first screening, age ≥ 30 years, family history of diabetes, and being overweight or obese.
mod_finding: Late-onset gestational diabetes significantly increased the risk of cesarean delivery.
